repair.why: Janus head of Tripo task 330872a3 (measured 2026-09-29, work/probe sheets): the side concept (drawn over ortho_left, face looking left) went into the RIGHT slot, so Tripo fitted a face on BOTH sides of the head (-Y: tripo_part_12 from the front concept; +Y: tripo_part_0 from the mirrored side profile) and swept the wings toward -Y. Turning the high-poly 180 deg about Z makes the side-consistent face (tripo_part_0, with a real nose/chin profile) the front and sweeps the wings back as in the side concept; the front-concept face part tripo_part_12 is dropped. The dropped face sat inside a feathered hood of the TORSO part tripo_part_1 (its neck column behind the head, authored y -0.026..0.070, rising to z 0.534 = eye level): that hood stays hollow after the drop (open toward +Y, its inside faces the viewer from behind) and reads from the elevated game camera as a smooth bald dome behind the crest (harpy-h2-bake/1 review, verifier frames 2026-09-29). Profile /2 trims it (repair.trim), closes the torso's neck opening with a closed cap (repair.caps) and covers the cap's upper half with a copy of the head's own back feathers (repair.patches). The back of tripo_part_0 itself is a closed feathered surface. The second ankle band tripo_part_11 (right leg after the turn) is kept because it is structural (see kept_parts_note). Repair of a generation defect, proposal; regeneration with the side view in the LEFT slot is the clean fix (followup)

drop_parts.tripo_part_12: front-concept face of the Janus head (source -Y); after the 180 deg turn it would be a second face on the back of the head. Its neck sat in the hood/neck column of tripo_part_1 (see repair.trim)

occluder_only_parts.tripo_part_7: Tripo base (gold cylinder, source Ø0.321 m): AO occluder under the feet only; the game base is the parametric SM_Harpy_Base (instance pips, team band)

kept_parts_note.tripo_part_11: second ankle band (on the RIGHT leg after the turn; the concept has one band, on the LEFT leg). Kept: it bridges the 2.2 cm (source) gap between the right shin (tripo_part_8, bottom z 0.166) and the right tarsus (tripo_part_9, top z 0.144); dropping it opened the leg (measured in the first low-poly front frame 2026-09-29). Deviation from the concept, recorded in the report

trim.why: hood / neck column of the torso that framed the dropped face tripo_part_12: faces with centroid above z 0.455 behind the head (authored frame, source scale; measured 2026-09-29: 15 829 of 266 455 high-poly faces, centroids x -0.055..0.057, y -0.026..0.070, z 0.455..0.534). Below z 0.455 the part is the collar ruff; the cut leaves one open loop around the neck (0.65 m, x -0.055..0.058, y -0.027..0.042, z 0.384..0.457), closed by repair.caps. Proposal

caps.name: cap_100
caps.why: closes the torso's neck opening left by repair.trim (and by the dropped tripo_part_12, whose neck filled it; harpy-h2-bake/1 closed only its lower back part with the ellipsoid plug_100 and left a see-through gap at the base of the head: 119-130 px at azimuth 180 / 4.8 m, measured by see_through.py). Closed domed cap on the loop's best-fit plane: skirt ring 12 % outside the loop and 4 mm under it (tucks under the collar), lip ring on the rim 3 mm up (a ray grazing the rim meets the cap before the rim's culled inner side), closed underside. Dark feather tone with a soft procedural scallop (Voronoi F1, baked into BC and N); prototypes 2026-09-29: ellipsoid plugs left 5-85 px see-through, the cap 0-1 px on the high-poly. Proposal

repair.patches_note: harpy-h2-bake/2 had patch_101 (the head's back feathers copied 4.5 cm back/down with a backing sheet): measured 2026-09-29 (scratch HP probe) it lay mostly UNDER the cap's plane - only 2-3 spikes showed, the cap stayed a smooth dark dome from every game azimuth. Replaced by repair.fills (H2.1)

fills.name: fill_102
fills.why: H2.1 nape: the smooth dark cap_100 read as a bald hood inside the collar from every game camera (scratch HP probe 2026-09-29: cap pixels 210 441 over 8 game azimuths at pitch -55, ortho 0.22 m). The dark collar feathers right of the neck (tripo_part_1, box above; Tripo UVs and texture, 10.9k HP faces) are laid 14 times on the cap (8 on the dome and the V down the back, 6 around the rim lip), each copy conformed to the cap surface with its relief (x0.7) and turned so its feathers point down the nape / out over the collar; faces of a copy that fall wholly beyond the cap are dropped. Probe: cap pixels 210 441 -> 13 441 (-94 %). Proposal

seat.note: 42 uu with the base = upper end of the proposed 35-42 uu (04 §3.2) and the previous candidate (harpy-segmented-skeletal/2); uniform scale about the Tripo base top centre, figure on the parametric base top; exact scale in h2-rig-report.json

lowpoly.method: Decimate COLLAPSE per part on the welded high-poly copy, priority vertex group protects the face
lowpoly.why_not_quadriflow: QuadriFlow needs closed manifold input and smooths thin features: every Tripo part is one shell with 264-2413 open edges (segmentation cuts), and the figure is mostly thin feather sheets (wing primaries, crest spikes, collar ruff) whose serrated outline is the silhouette; collapse decimation keeps those outlines (measured: surface distance high->low per part in h2-lowpoly-report.json)

tripo_part_0.role: head: face, pointed ears, feather crest, back collar

priority_regions.name: face
priority_regions.note: skin-coloured face and ears of the head part (source probe: skin v>0.45 s<0.4 at source y>0.15, z 0.424-0.518), turned 180 deg
priority_regions.min_triangles_note: uniform decimation of the head part to 5000 gives the face box 639 triangles (measured 2026-09-29, 12.8 %, = its share of the high-poly vertices); 1200 = about 2x

tripo_part_1.role: torso: chest, collar ruff, back, short tail (hood of the Janus face trimmed, repair.trim)

tripo_part_6.role: left leg: feathered thigh, shin, gold ankle band

tripo_part_10.role: left foot: scaled tarsus, toes, talons

cap_100.role: neck cap (repair of the trimmed hood / dropped Janus face part)
cap_100.target_note: H2.1: the decimation ratio is target / polygons and the cap is built of quads + fans (512 polygons = 896 triangles): target 500 of harpy-h2-bake/2 left 874 triangles; 250 gives about 440. The cap is now under the nape fill

fill_102.role: nape feathers: 14 conformed copies of dark collar feathers over the neck cap (repair.fills, H2.1)

lowpoly.keep_tripo_uv_note: measured 2026-09-29: Tripo charts per part 70 (part_4) / 221 (part_0) / 133 (part_1); collapse decimation with the UVs kept leaves 89 / 295 / 178 islands with 26-29 flipped UV triangles per part; the own-seam alternatives (Smart UV / sharp-edge seams / chart merging + SLIM) gave 1.8k-8.4k islands for 25.7k triangles and a 25-33 % atlas fill

stitch.note: the Tripo parts are one surface cut into parts: neighbouring high-poly parts share their cut vertex for vertex (12 part pairs, 36 shared chains, e.g. inner/outer right wing), but the per-part decimation moved each boundary on its own and opened sub-millimetre cracks. One-sided game-camera frames (see_through.py, 36 frames) of the unstitched game mesh: 212 see-through pixels, 0-15 per frame; stitched: 49, 0-4 per frame (measured 2026-09-29 on the harpy-h2-bake/2 mesh). Stitching projects both boundaries onto the high-poly cut, clusters vertices closer than merge_m, inserts the other part's vertices (~1.3k, +~1.3k triangles) and puts a vertex of both parts on every open chain end (three-part corners). max_edge_factor 3.0 folded a wing corner (max high->low distance of tripo_part_2 6.4 mm), 1.5 keeps it at 3.2 mm (unstitched 3.3 mm). Repair parts (cap, patch) are excluded: they overlap, they do not share cuts. Proposal

lowpoly.fix_nonmanifold_note: harpy-h2-bake/2 left 3 edges with more than two faces after the stitch (tripo_part_10: 1, tripo_part_6: 2; decimation pinches, not in the Tripo cut). seal.fix_nonmanifold splits the end vertex fan (same position, nothing opens). Proposal

uv.note: one UV0 atlas for the whole figure; pack margin 12 px of 4096 (fraction) so that the measured free texels between islands stay >= 8 at 4K (4 at the 2K runtime mip); face islands x2 texel density, feet/talon islands x1.5 (lowpoly.parts.*.priority_regions)

ao.note: 0.08 x the source figure height 0.634 m (W4-B atlas.ao_bake distance_rel 0.08)

bake.note: authored frame at source scale (before the seat transform); extrusion 2 mm / ray 6 mm from the cage: the high->low surface distance is p99 0.7-1.4 mm, max 1.4-3.6 mm per part (h2-lowpoly-report.json); a larger cage reaches the next feather layer of the same part

recolor.why: after the 180 deg turn the torso's skin-coloured V below the old front face sits at the back of the neck (review frame closeup_neck_back); the concept back shows dark feathers there. Skin-like texels (v > 0.45, s < 0.4) of the torso inside the box are tinted to the dark feather tone keeping their luminance detail. Repair, proposal
recolor.box_note: first run with z >= 0.33 also darkened light tan chest feathers below the V (speckles, review 2026-09-29); the V itself lies at source z 0.373-0.397; harpy-h2-bake/2 adds a narrow second box (|x| <= 0.022, z 0.352-0.37) for the light tip of the V that stayed visible below the neck cap from behind (verified on the high-poly vertex mask 2026-09-29: z >= 0.35 over the full width selects speckles on the tan feathers again, the narrow box does not)

bake.device_note: measured 2026-09-29 (two full rebuilds at the same path): OptiX AO bit-identical; OptiX normal/EMIT passes differ by <= 4.2e-7 on 3-6 M texels, i.e. 10-863 texels one 8-bit step apart in the PNGs; Cycles CPU for those passes (W4-B: Cycles CPU repeats byte for byte)

team_mask.note: W4-B rule of Harpy (harpy-segmented-skeletal/3 team_color.mask: no cloth; the dark flight feathers of the wings carry the team colour, v <= 0.22 on the sRGB BC, ramp 0.05, blur 3x3) applied to the four H2 wing parts. Format = W4-B TeamMask (separate 8-bit linear L texture, UE reads .R). Proposal

metal_rule.note: Tripo PBR left the gold ankle bands non-metallic (metallic > 0.5 on 0 texels of the figure, measured 2026-09-29); the concept paints them as antique gold/bronze. Proposal: gold-coloured texels (sRGB hue 30-62 deg, s >= 0.45, v >= 0.45) of the two leg parts that carry a band get metallic 1.0 / roughness 0.35 with a soft 3x3 edge

materials.note: H2.1 material pass (proposal): user brief 2026-09-29 - feathers metallic 0 roughness 0.70-0.85, talons dark horn metallic 0 roughness 0.40-0.55, gold bands stay textures.metal_rule (metallic 1, roughness 0.35); face: baked cavity + darkening local contrast for the K2 read

feathers.why: Tripo roughness 0.65-0.94 per part (p5-p95), mean 0.77, metallic 0: remapped into 0.70-0.85, half the part's own Tripo rank, half the baked AO (exposed vanes smoother, occluded roots rougher); face/ear skin (v > 0.45, s < 0.4 on the head part), the gold bands and the talons excluded

talons.why: the claws are the desaturated dark texels of the feet parts (Tripo sRGB v 0.16-0.35, s < 0.3; the scale crevices are saturated brown): roughness 0.40 (dark) - 0.55 (lighter), metallic 0, base colour x0.75 toward the black horn of the concept

face_cavity.why: face islands (UV priority x2): base colour x (1 - 0.5 cavity - 0.6 dark detail), cavity = local AO deficit (gaussian 6 px of the 4K bake), dark detail = relative luminance below a 3 px blur (brows, lids, nostrils, lip line): darkening only, so the painted features keep their shape and survive the 2K mips at K2

base_parametric.azimuth_convention: degrees in the XY plane from +X counter-clockwise; -90 = -Y = the figure's front

clearance.note: every pip edge > min_m (XY) from any body vertex lower than band_m above the base top

pips.note: 3 sectors 120 deg apart, so for any yaw one sector faces the camera within ±60 deg. The talon tips reach r 8.4 uu (source r 0.127 x scale), the pips span r 8.65-10.45 uu on the flat top (r ≤ 10.6 uu). Pips are raised 0.04 uu with a 0.06 uu skirt (no z-fighting with the top); every pip exists in every instance, unlit pips take the base colour
pips.search_note: the H2 talons reach further out than the previous candidate's; the three pip sectors (120 deg apart) are turned by the offset (0..118 deg, step 2, preferring the one nearest the previous -90/30/150) with every pip edge > clearance.min_m from the feet in XY; smaller ring radii only if no offset clears

channels.R: team band: side wall and chamfer (TeamColor, 03 С-11: team colour only on bases/rings/markers)

mask.instance_rule: InstanceIndex 1 -> centre pips (•), 2 -> outer pips (• •), 3 -> all (•••): lit = G * (Index != 2) + B * (Index >= 2)
mask.values_note: binary 0/1 per channel, so sRGB/linear vertex-colour conversion cannot shift them

preview_colours_linear.team_note: 03 С-11 hex converted sRGB -> linear: #E8C06A = sRGB (0.910, 0.753, 0.416) = linear (0.807, 0.527, 0.144); #9FC2D8 = sRGB (0.624, 0.761, 0.847) = linear (0.347, 0.539, 0.686). The Merlin/Arthur profiles list hex/255 (sRGB) values as 'linear'

The task text named UM_HUMANOID_17_v1: its only difference for Harpy is an unweighted leaf weapon under hand.L

see_through.note: two gates (proposal). gate_strict = the verifier's gate 2026-09-29: with back faces culled as in UE (M_UM_Figure TwoSided=false) no background pixel may show through the figure in the game camera (FOV 35, pitch -55, 1920x1080) at 4.8 and 7.5 m for azimuths 120..240 - reported. gate = stage gate: no opening, i.e. no 8-connected see-through component of 4 px or more at any of the 18 azimuths (the harpy-h2-bake/1 neck gap had components of 69 and 44 px at azimuth 180 / 4.8 m); isolated 1-3 px pinholes (sub-millimetre cracks left between parts) are counted and reported

revision_note: H2.1 (2026-09-29): targeted pass over harpy-h2-bake/2 - nape fill of real feather clusters over the neck cap (repair.fills, patch_101 dropped), non-manifold fix after the stitch, contact lips against the see-through pinholes (seal), material rules (feathers, talons, gold base), face cavity. Proposal

seal.note: H2.1 see-through seal (seal.py), after the UV stage in stage_rig (authored frame, source metres). Scratch measurements 2026-09-29 on the H2.1 low-poly (see_through, 18 azimuths x 3.86/4.8/7.5/12.07 m): no seal 943 px (the nape fill's backs against the sky from the front, 1-8 px pinholes elsewhere); contact lips alone 902; exposed back faces alone 61; core + fill back faces 7; core + fill back faces + slivers + lips 0. Proposal

slivers.why: boundary edges with both ends on a neighbour's boundary vertices but another path between them (stitch skipped the insertion, max_edge_factor): the sliver is filled by a fan of the part

lips.why: non-shared boundary edges within 2.5 mm of another part get a lip to 0.5 mm past the neighbour

core.name: core_103
core.why: closed occluder inside head/torso/thighs: a ray that slips through a crack between parts meets its front face (one dark texel of the cap island) instead of culled back faces; weights copied from the nearest body vertex (weights.copy_nearest)

exposed.why: the nape fill is an open sheet laid on the cap: its triangles whose back side is seen from a game direction (ray to the camera escapes) get a detached reversed copy

base_material.note: H2.1 metal base (proposal; UE not touched): the parametric base keeps its mesh, pips and vertex mask; UV0 re-laid by base_gold.uv_layout, own 1K texture set T_Harpy_H2_Base_{BC,N,ORM} (base_textures.py). UE route: M_UM_BaseMarker MI with BaseColorTexture/NormalTexture/ORMTexture = these, BaseColor (1,1,1), VertexMaskWeight 1 (team band + pips from the vertex mask), SideBandWeight 0, BandKeepsTexture 0, PipColor / PipEmissive as before. M_UM_BaseMarker takes Metallic = ORM.B and Roughness = lerp(RoughnessMin, RoughnessMax, ORM.G), so the texture carries the metal

top.why: antique gold / bronze leaf of the concept base (concept front, base median sRGB (0.66, 0.50, 0.26) = linear (0.39, 0.21, 0.06) as lit); kept darker than the lit pips (instance read: pip - top >= 40 luma, analyse_instances.py)

band.why: bright gold (shows only with BandKeepsTexture 1; the default flat team band takes its ORM: metal)
